about_the_game:
FIREBIRD – A Fairy-Tale Action-Adventure Platformer. Dark and Fun.

Firebird is a fast-paced 2D action-adventure platformer set in a haunting fairy-tale world where myths fade and shadows come alive. Built in Unreal Engine 5, Firebird challenges players with tight traversal, creative puzzles, and stylish platforming-driven combat.

Agility and timing are everything. From wall jumps to monster vaults, every movement is a weapon—and every level introduces a new mechanic to master. Whether you’re dodging death traps or reshaping reality in dreamlike sub-levels, Firebird never stops evolving.

What Makes Firebird Special:

  • Platforming is the Core – Combat, exploration, and problem-solving are all driven by movement.

  • A World Full of Secrets – Explore three eerie biomes and surreal Dream Worlds where light and shadow shift the rules.

  • Epic Boss Fights – Outsmart mythical guardians using skillful traversal and smart mechanics.

  • Stunning Visuals – Dark fantasy meets magical realism in gorgeous 2.5D levels powered by Unreal Engine 5.

  • No Filler, All Killer – Fresh mechanics in every stage. Tight pacing. Zero grind.

    Planned for PC and consoles in Q1 2026, Firebird blends the challenge of Hollow Knight with the magic of Ori and the Blind Forest, offering an unforgettable ride through a fading world—and a second chance to reignite its flame.

name: Firebird

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for performance
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller support recommended for best experience
